facts.fact: Kit 三个月前父母被杀后一直被留在 Soren 的宅子里，几乎不出自己的房间。
facts.anchor: Three months; nearly three months since that night, and I still don’t know if I’m crying because Mom and Dad are gone… or because I

facts.fact: Soren 当晚跪在 Kit 父母尸体旁、手里的枪还热着，两人额头各有一个整齐弹孔，还把 Kit 当没处理的隐患。
facts.anchor: The man who knelt beside my parents’ bodies with a gun still warm in his hand. The man who looked at the neat bullet holes in both of their foreheads and then looked at me, like I was nothing more than a loose end he hadn’t decided what to do with yet.

facts.fact: Lorraine 每天都来，是这个地方唯一对 Kit 温和的人，送饭、敲门但不强闯。
facts.anchor: Lorraine comes every day; she’s the only kindness in this place.

facts.fact: Kit 二十岁、本是个大学生，父母遇害前的生活是课本、深夜写代码、妈妈做饭的家。
facts.anchor: I don’t belong here… I was just a college kid. I’m only twenty.

facts.fact: Kit 试图逃跑过一次：半夜爬窗、光脚落地只跑了三步，看见持手电的保安就翻回去了。
facts.anchor: I know I can’t escape; I tried once. Climbed out of my bedroom window

facts.fact: Lorraine 以 boss 出门办事了劝动 Kit 跟她去厨房吃东西。
facts.anchor: the boss is out on business.

facts.fact: Selina 进厨房招呼 Kit，自我介绍叫 Selina，还叫他 Kitty。
facts.anchor: Well, hi, Kitty… oh, I’m Selina by the way.

facts.fact: Soren 回来呵斥 Selina 不许和 Kit 沟通、领了任务就去干。
facts.anchor: You don’t fucking communicate with him, Selina. I gave you a task, get to it,

facts.fact: Soren 对 Kit 说的第一句话点他终于离开了房间，用的称呼是 Christopher。
facts.anchor: So, you finally left your room, Christopher.

facts.fact: Lorraine 替 Kit 补充说他更愿意被叫 Kit。
facts.anchor: Oh, he prefers to be called Kit.

facts.fact: Soren 抓住 Kit 的下巴逼他抬眼对视，问他是不是怕他。
facts.anchor: His hand comes up and grabs my chin, forcing my face up until I have no choice but to look at him.

facts.fact: Soren 最后喝令 Kit 出去并喊出 Christopher，Kit 快步僵直地逃出厨房。
facts.anchor: Now, Christopher!” The shout cracks through the room.
